question: Who became the first folk artist from India to walk the Cannes red carpet in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mame Khan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Mame Khan is a renowned Rajasthani folk singer known for his work in the Manganiyar tradition.
 
• He became the first Indian folk artist to walk the Cannes red carpet in May 2022.
 
• Mame Khan was part of the Indian delegation led by Information and Broadcasting Minister Anurag Thakur.
 
• His participation highlighted the rich cultural heritage of India on a global platform like Cannes.
 
• Mame Khan has previously contributed to several Bollywood soundtracks and international music festivals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cannes Film Festival:**

 
 
• One of the most prestigious film festivals in the world, held annually in Cannes, France.
 
• It showcases new films of all genres, including documentaries, from around the world.
 
• It was founded in 1946 and is known for its Palme d'Or award.
 
 
 
• **Manganiyar Tradition:**
 
 
• A community of Muslim folk musicians from Rajasthan, known for their storytelling through music.
 
• Their performances often include instruments like the khartal, dholak, and kamaicha.
 
• They have a rich repertoire of traditional songs passed down through generations.
 
 
 
• **Bollywood Contributions:**
 
 
• Mame Khan has lent his voice to popular Bollywood films such as "Luck By Chance" and "No One Killed Jessica".
 
• His unique folk style has brought an authentic regional flavor to these soundtracks.
 
 
 
• **International Recognition:**
 
 
• In addition to Cannes, Mame Khan has performed at various international music festivals.
 
• His work has helped promote Rajasthani folk music on global stages.
